{{AnimePokémonInfobox | type1=Fire | ball=None| nickname=Torkoal | jnickname=コータス | tmnickname=Cotoise | image=[[File:Torkoal BET.png|200px]] | caption=Torkoal in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team | gender=Male | caught=no | ability=Unknown | pokemonname=Torkoal| media=game| noevo=incap | firststagename=Torkoal | prevonum=324 | epnum=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness | current=Unknown | }} '''Torkoal''' (Japanese: '''コータス''' ''Cotoise'') is a [[non-player character]] in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky}}. ==In the games== Torkoal is first met when the {{pkmn2|hero}} and their {{md|Partner Pokémon|partner}} clear [[Waterfall Cave]] for the first time. He tells them to rest in the [[Hot Spring]] before going back. Later, when the hero and their partner are trying to find the location of the [[Hidden Land]], he comes to the [[Wigglytuff's Guild]] and tells the Guild about a pattern. After that, he examines the partner's [[Relic Fragment]] and tells the Guild that the pattern on the Relic Fragment is the pattern. Later on, {{mdc|Wigglytuff|2}} then remembers a similar pattern at the end of [[Brine Cave]], which {{mdc|Chatot|2}}, who was with Wigglytuff at the time, also recalls. Torkoal is the town elder and the wisest of all Pokémon in [[Treasure Town]]. He can usually be found relaxing at the Hot Spring, which is where he is found before and after he is asked about the location of the Hidden Land. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{fire color dark}}; background: #{{fire color}}; font-size:80%;" |- |style="{{roundy|5px}} border: 2px solid #{{fire color dark}}; background: #{{fire color light}}; width:240px"| [[File:MDP E 324.png]][[File:MDP E 324 Thought.png]][[File:MDP E 324 Surprised.png]] |- |Portraits from
